msg: Hold your index fingers over S and K and keep your thumb(s) lightly on the space bar. Start by selecting any gnomes and discover which of the pairs (green vs red, purple vs brown) provides the larger reward - this is usually quite obvious. Keep selecting those gnomes until the rewards drop below 3/4 mushrooms. Then switch to an alternative gnome. The person before me suggested that gnomes share baskets, but I think it is randomly decided which gnomes produce a higher output and often, the probability of getting a high reward from each gnome changes. If you are getting ZERO, SWITCH gnome. Occasionally, experiment with the opposite gnome just to see if it's giving higher rewards (call this exploration) but try and maximise selecting gnomes giving the higher rewards (exploitation). GOOD LUCK!
